item.title: [400] Mega Man: Dual Override Devs Talk Proto Man, Share New Details
item.description:
>You cannot switch between Mega Man and Proto Man during a playthrough. You choose to play as Mega Man or Proto Man at the start of the game.

>Stage design between Mega Man and Proto Man is mostly the same, but enemy placement changes between the two campaigns. The team wants players to encounter surprises on a second playthrough rather than already knowing exactly which enemy is coming next.

>The team wanted to include Proto Man as a playable character from the start of development, in part due to fan requests. The name Dual Override came later.

>Dual Override's two art directors are Yuji Ishihara and Shinsuke Komaki. For the game's main visual, Ishihara produced the rough composition and Komaki finished it. Ishihara handled Mega Man while Komaki handled Proto Man.

>In past games, character designs have generally balanced "cool" and "cute." With Dual Override, Ishihara and Komaki pushed things further toward cool, partly to appeal to a broader audience.

>While the basic storyline between Mega Man and Proto Man will be the same, the team says Proto Man will have more characterization than usual. Ikuta points out that Proto Man traditionally hasn't spoken very much, but because he is now a lead protagonist, there will be more opportunities for his personality to shine.

>While designing Proto Man, Komaki remembered that he has a faulty power core and began thinking about how to incorporate that into his design. Komaki sketched Proto Man overheating and venting heat, then pitched the idea internally. From there, the art concept became an actual gameplay mechanic, with the planners determining how venting would function in-game.

item.title: [ 68] Trump, Republicans so hated that KANSAS is going blue
item.description:
https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/6096719-hamilton-leads-marshall-kansas-senate-poll/

Democrat Adam Hamilton narrowly leads Republican Sen. Roger Marshall in a tight race for Senate in Kansas, according to new polling.

A new The Hill/Emerson College Polling survey found Hamilton ahead by 2 percentage points, with 45 percent support to Marshall’s 43 percent. Another 4 percent of respondents chose Libertarian candidate David Graham, and 8 percent were undecided.

“This poll finds Democrats with their best chance to win their first Senate seat in Kansas since 1932, in part driven by Democrat Hamilton’s appeal to independent voters, leading by 15 points,” said Spencer Kimball, executive director of Emerson College Polling.

Cook Political Report shifted its rating of the race toward Democrats last month, from “solid” to “likely” Republican, citing Hamilton’s primary win as a promising sign for Democrats hoping to break “a nearly century-long Senate losing streak” in Kansas. Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) also considers the race likely Republican.

Hamilton, senior pastor of the Church of the Resurrection, is campaigning to become the first Democrat to win a Sunflower State Senate race since former Sen. George McGill in 1932. Marshall is vying for a second term after winning the seat by double digits in 2020.

Former Kansas Gov. Bill Graves (R) backed Hamilton this week, saying the country is “facing increasing partisan gridlock and division” and that it’s “time Kansas does something different.”

A Kansas wacko is behind bars after allegedly threatening to kill conservative podcaster Ben Shapiro, who opened up about daily security concerns in a new interview.

Others claimed Shapiro would be killed “for being Jewish,” or else called him a “stupid jew,” with police determining the countdown to the supposed murder plot coincided with this year’s Yom Kippur dates.

The threats weren’t just reserved for Shapiro – Strube allegedly named President Trump, the Obamas and suggested his social media behavior had somehow led to the death of Shapiro’s fellow conservative commentator Charlie Kirk.

The posts were flagged to police by a security firm hired by Shapiro – who said the threats were “not veiled” and had a “level of gravity.”

Officials quickly tracked the X account to an address near Topeka, where Strube was found living with his parents.

Strube owned up to making the posts, police alleged, before launching a disturbed tale about government spies who were sending him messages through song lyrics and presidential addresses.

Texas Democrats have allegedly found a “roundabout” way to pay for votes in the critical Senate and governor’s races, according to an undercover video published Wednesday.

A Democratic operative with Texas Majority PAC admitted in the new footage released by the conservative outlet Townhall that the group is shelling out $25 per person for attendance at Zoom classes that discuss “bad things” Republicans are doing.

“We are paying people $25 to attend a one-hour Zoom class to learn why voting is important and why the Republicans are causing all of these bad things,” said Sky MacAdams, an organizing manager for Texas Majority PAC.

item.description:
https://abcnews.com/Politics/rep-thomas-massie-forcing-vote-pete-hegseths-impeachment/story?id=136470894

Outgoing Republican Rep. Thomas Massie seized the House floor for more than an hour Tuesday afternoon, launching a long-shot effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stemming from his controversial administration over the Pentagon, including the war in Iran.

After sending a news release announcing his intent to impeach Hegseth, Massie quickly appeared on the floor where he stood for more than 67 minutes reading the sweeping 34-page resolution with eight articles of impeachment aloud.

"Secretary Hegseth has acted in a manner contrary to his trust as Secretary of Defense and subversive of constitutional government, to the great prejudice of the cause of law and justice, and to the manifest injury of the people of the United States of America," Massie read from the resolution, contending that Hegseth will "remain a threat to civilians and the laws of war, the integrity of United States diplomacy, and the Constitution if allowed to remain in office, and has acted in a manner grossly incompatible with his duties and the rule of law."

"Peter Brian Hegseth thus warrants impeachment and trial, removal from office, and disqualification to hold and enjoy any office of honor, trust, or profit under the United States," the resolution states.

The Pentagon responded to Massie's move, defending Hegseth in a statement to ABC News.

"Secretary Hegseth has been a transformative leader for the Department of War," Pentagon press secretary Kingsley Wilson said in the statement, later adding that the "entire Department is unified behind the Secretary’s vision and will continue working to put our warfighters and America first."

item.title: [260] /rcg/ | /tpg/ - Roller Coaster General | Theme Park General
item.description:
AF1 saved edition

>Last Thread: >>2904031

>What is this thread? Why are there two generals?
/rcg/ was initially created as a way for the roller coaster enthusiasts on here to discuss all things roller coasters and theme parks. While roller coasters are the main focus of these threads (and the title of the general) there is also discussion on other theme parks, their rides, as well as the parks themselves and trip planning too. That's where /tpg/ comes in.
>Can I talk about Disney/Universal parks in this thread?
Absolutely! Disney/Universal discussion of all sorts including rides/resorts/dining/trip planning is OK.

General Rules:

item.title: [118] USA travel cont'd: tripping thru Texas addition
item.description:
Say hi to the friendly neighbor dog who up and joined me on an LSD-infused four mile stroll through the 95° sunshine and greenery of east Texas in August. Pretty comfy desu, it's lovely to never be cold. Humidity is moderate compared to Southeast Asia, doesn't bother me at all.

Tomorrow me and my brother drive across the state to repo his car from his ex fiance. The roadtrip is going to kickstart the next episode of adventures across America, with an eight-day itinerary stopping at various Deep South cities on my way to the East Coast.

Despite poison ivy and blisters from yard projects, it felt good to have a house to relax in deep in the unvisited countryside of east Texas. But after a week here, I'm eager to get a move on and bask in the warmth of a southern summertime while traversing some very black ghettoish places. Got a couple tabs left over for my next fraternal reunion on the East Coast...this is the life. Own nothing, be happy. Overseas to home country without missing a beat, keep it moving, spend that cash, don't let it rot in the bank. Some other anon said $5K is his return-to-work threshold. Good idea. Enjoy the fruits of your labor while you can; health and freedom are temporal privileges which Fate can revoke any minute.

Would be nice to take this all the way up to Quebec and the Maritimes before summer wraps up. We'll see how far it goes.

item.title: [157] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.

item.title: [301] /out/ings with a pipe
item.description:
Last thread >>2856593

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
